offering_description.value: Sells digital learning content, a learning platform and training courses to large enterprises and government bodies for workforce skills development. Mainly delivered through annual subscriptions, with instructor-led training and certification sold on top.

primary_products.value: e-learning content library; learning management platform; IT training courses

customer_segment.value: B2B: large enterprises and their employees; B2G: government agencies and public-sector organizations

end_markets.value: technology; financial services; healthcare; manufacturing; government

revenue_model.value: subscription: annual access to content library and learning platform; service fees: instructor-led courses, certification exams and training services

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: learning platform and content library sold to corporate buyers; service provider: training delivery and certification sold to enterprises

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: content library, learning platform and IT training courses sold to the same corporate customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: enterprise and government account teams; partners / resellers: channel and reseller partners selling to smaller customers; online: digital delivery of courses through the cloud platform

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy and security rules for employee data, such as GDPR and US state privacy laws

notes: Unsure whether all training units, such as the Global Knowledge business, are still owned, so the offering list may be out of date.
